description: Solution for long term memory for agent coding CLIs and to facilitate handoff between different agent vendors
vibe: Markdown-in-git is truth, SQLite is just the index, and every retrieved memory is untrusted evidence.
highlights: Markdown-in-git is the source of truth; SQLite is a derived index that can be rebuilt.
All retrieved memory is treated as untrusted historical data, never as instructions to execute.
Per-project isolation by construction: every row and page keyed by (workspace_id, project_id, path).
LLM is strictly opt-in; zero-LLM mode still captures, searches, and writes rule-based summaries.
One canonical instruction file per repo; CLAUDE.md is only a pointer, never a duplicate.
assessment: This file demonstrates unusually mature taste by separating durable truth (git-backed markdown) from derived state (SQLite), which makes the system auditable and recoverable. Its security posture is notably disciplined: it explicitly refuses to trust retrieved memory as instructions and bounds all sanitization, avoiding the classic prompt-injection trap in agent memory systems. The insistence on a single canonical instruction file and explicit scope routing shows a systems thinker optimizing for cross-harness continuity rather than vendor lock-in.
